worldcombat.skill.withdraw.summary: Raise Defense and block a limited number of attacks while unable to move.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.use.0: Eat a burst: pull in and let the shell block the incoming hits one by one
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.use.1: When focused, stay rooted and spend shell charges to buy allies time
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.use.2: Take a short window to raise Defense before poking back out
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.description.0: Shelled: Defense +%1$s stages, and the shell blocks the next %2$s hits from enemies outright, for about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.deep.on: Deep dive: thicker shell, one more block, lasts longer, at the cost of a slower close, a longer cooldown and being rooted longer.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.deep.off: Shallow tuck: a thin shell with one block only, but it closes sooner, cools down faster and lets you come back out quicker.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.growth.0: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.growth.1: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.preference.de: On: thicker shell, one more block, lasts longer, at the cost of a slower close, a longer cooldown and being rooted longer. Off: a thin shell with one block only, but it closes, cools down and reopens much sooner.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.preference.ai: Consider tucking in when a threat is within this distance; larger pulls in from further out.
Below this health fraction the companion tucks in ahead of the shared order; higher enters the turtle stance earlier, lower waits until nearly down.
worldcombat.skill.withdraw.description.s: The shell only stops attacks from enemies, not self-inflicted or environmental damage; when its hits run out or its time ends the shell cracks open and the Defence it raised is taken back.
